name: Pfizer, Inc.
research_rationale: Q3 filing restores quarterly profit and alliance growth, but YTD impairments, legal costs, leverage and thin GAAP earnings coverage temper the screen buy case.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 results (3 Nov 8-K/10-Q): $16.6bn revenue, $0.56 diluted EPS; nine-month GAAP earnings still down sharply on impairments and legal charges.  
Starna Therapeutics exclusive licensing (up to $2.6bn, announced 18 Nov) adds CAR-T autoimmune programmes; press debate continues on dividend cover and patent cliff.
